newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates unchanged in dull trading.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates unchanged in dull trading.

text.p: Pakistani cotton prices were unchanged on Monday in lacklustre trading but are likely to be dragged down by the hangover from the 1996/97 (July-June) crop in the near term, dealers said.

"Only exporters are showing some interest, but overall demand is low," dealer Khushi Ram said. "The rates will slip as there are still more than 800,000 bales of unsold cotton available with ginners, while the arrival of the new crop is due early next month."
The kerb market rates for NIAB-78 variety were around 1,850 rupees ($45.75) per maund (37.32 k.g.) and for the K-68 around 2,000 rupees.
